thread:
marta.finance: NodePulse just sent a chargeback. Invoice INV-5733 billed reserved pool rp-aggregator-01 to NodePulse for June but metering shows the pool was actually consumed by MedTrack (cust_medtrack). Theyre asking for refund + corrected invoice.
dev.ops: Oof. This sounds like the aggregator attribution bug we thought was low-risk. Can someone attach the invoice + provisioning/metering dump?
billing-bot: Invoice INV-5733 uploaded: https://invoices.redwood/INV-5733.pdf
billing-bot: Metering summary (rp-aggregator-01): total_committed_hours=2,160, consumers={cust_medtrack:2100, cust_nodepulse:60} | invoice_assigned_to=cust_nodepulse
tj.sales: Quick context: NodePulse resells our Dedicated pools to several small clinics. MedTrack is a vendor who bought a dedicated slice but is on a separate contract. If the invoice shows NodePulse but usage belongs to MedTrack that's a cross-customer misattribution.
marta.finance: Econ calc: Invoice charged NodePulse reserved = $13,000; real owed by MedTrack reserved portion ~$12,000; NodePulse actually used burst $360 for their tiny usage. If NodePulse already paid, we owe them ~ $12,640 net (refund/credit).
anne.revenue: We need a clean audit trail. Options: (1) reissue corrected invoices for both customers (complex, legal & AR), (2) apply ledger reallocation: debit NodePulse account, credit MedTrack and leave internal journal to clear, (3) offer NodePulse operational credit and corrected invoice for MedTrack. Legal input required for cross-customer ledger moves.
legal-bot: Cross-customer fund reallocation requires signed consent from both customers unless covered by our TOS clause for invoicing errors. Standard process: offer corrected invoices and ledger notes; only do direct fund transfers with written customer approval.
dev.ops: Root cause: aggregator attribution job (tenant-aggregator service) had a race during pool split on 2026-06-01 deploy; mapping cache expired and defaulted to the primary tenant (nodepulse) when rendering invoices. Patch merged. I'll paste the provisioning audit query output.
```
SELECT pool_id, consumer_id, event_time, assigned_invoice_tenant
FROM provisioning.audit
WHERE pool_id='rp-aggregator-01' AND date(event_time) BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY event_time;
```
dev.ops: Output rows: (rp-aggregator-01, cust_medtrack, 2026-06-01T00:02:12Z, cust_medtrack), (rp-aggregator-01, cust_medtrack, 2026-06-15T12:34:01Z, cust_medtrack), (rp-aggregator-01, cust_nodepulse, 2026-06-28T23:59:59Z, cust_nodepulse) | invoice_render_snapshot: assigned to cust_nodepulse (buggy fallback).
tj.sales: NodePulse is upset; they already applied the payment to their downstream invoices. MedTrack demanding corrected invoice for their auditors. Customer relations ask for a fast resolution to avoid cascades.
marta.finance: Given legal constraints, recommended approach: (A) Offer NodePulse an operational goodwill credit equal to $12,640 and attach ledger note explaining rendering error; (B) Issue corrected invoice to MedTrack for reserved portion and bill them the reserved amount (or offset if they already paid); (C) internal journal entry to reconcile revenue recognition. This avoids moving funds between customer ledgers. Approve?
anne.revenue: That seems pragmatic. Approve operational credit up to $13k for NodePulse contingent on NodePulse accepting credit instead of cash refund. Also approve issuing corrected invoice to MedTrack. Need explicit "approve" from legal for the ledger/journal approach.
legal-bot: approve-approach-with-consent. Confirming: legal approves credit + corrected invoices; require NodePulse consent to credit (we cannot auto-refund into another customer). If NodePulse requests cash refund instead, AR will process it once approved by finance lead.
marta.finance: Please reply "approve" to finalize. We'll also need ops to add monitoring alert for mismatched pool_id between metering and invoice rendering. And a short postmortem in the ticket.
dev.ops: Patch merged, monitoring alert created: invoice.render.pool_mismatch (threshold >0). Runbook entry: https://runbooks.redwood/tenant-aggregator-pool-fallback.
tj.sales: I'll ping NodePulse CS with the proposed wording: "We discovered an invoicing rendering error that attributed MedTrack usage to your account. We're offering a one-time operational credit of $12,640 to your account and will issue a corrected invoice to MedTrack; please confirm if you'd prefer a refund instead of the credit."
nodepulse-cs (via tj.sales): NodePulse response: "prefer credit applied to account rather than refund; need ledger note for our auditors."
marta.finance: NodePulse consent received. Booking adjustment ADJ-2026-789 | customer: cust_nodepulse | amount: -12640 | reason: invoicing_render_error_credit | linked_invoice: INV-5733. Will attach ledger note and invoice copies.
billing-bot: Ledger entry created: ADJ-2026-789 | customer: cust_nodepulse | amount: -12640 | reason: invoicing_render_error_credit | linked_invoice: INV-5733
anne.revenue: Also confirm corrected invoice to MedTrack INV-5733-R1 issued and revenue journal posted to shift recognized revenue to MedTrack's account. Finance to coordinate revenue rebooking so ARR metrics are accurate.
marta.finance: Creating corrected invoice INV-5733-R1 for cust_medtrack and internal revenue journal RJ-2026-90 to reallocate recognized revenue. AR will not process cross-customer cash moves.
legal-bot: We'll prepare a short customer-facing note for both parties to include in the corrected invoice package.
dev.ops: Adding postmortem link to ticket and closing the loop on the fix.
marta.finance: Closing: (1) ADJ-2026-789 posted, (2) INV-5733-R1 created, (3) RJ-2026-90 created for internal revenue reallocation, (4) ops monitoring + runbook added, (5) CS notified both customers. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
